test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The 'Seven Sisters of India' does NOT include which of the following states?
solution:
Correct answer is__** Sikkim.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Sikkim is **a State in Northeast India**.
 
• It is be one of fastest growing, **multiethnic and multilingual Indian state.**
 
• It borders **Tibet in the north and northeast,** Bhutan in the east, Nepal in the west and West Bengal in the south.
 
• SIkkim is also situated near to **India's Siliguri corridor near Bangladesh.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The Seven Sister States is a famous word for the contiguous states of **Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Meghalaya, Manipur, Mizoram, Nagaland and Tripura.****​ **
 
• Arunachal Pradesh is famous for **its pristine beauty and the lush green forests**.
 
• Nagaland is also popularly known as the '**land of festivals.**
 
• Meghalaya, also famous as the **Abode of Clouds, falls in one of the richest biodiversity areas in the world. **
